title: Deliver the reproducible print and JSON receipt

acceptance.how: Confirm canonical input/source/catalogue/method fingerprints and timestamp separation from G2.
acceptance.verification: Identical scientific inputs reproduce identities; changed evidence changes them.

acceptance.text: Implement JSON download and basic print
acceptance.how: Render current comparison, windows, check labels, versions, unknowns and limits from the actual response.
acceptance.verification: No separate PDF service, cloud account or illustrative export fallback.

acceptance.text: Check export parity, layout and privacy
acceptance.how: Compare exported/printed result with screen/API; check incomplete states and phone print layout; avoid public field URLs.
acceptance.verification: Versions/status/units/limitations survive; no client-side science recomputation.

acceptance.text: Review and hand off the farmer receipt
acceptance.how: Hla checks language; Saim/Maruf check evidence labels; Fardin checks reproduction.
acceptance.verification: Actual output and independent review/merge evidence recorded.

handoff: Record reviewed outputs, exact revision and next consumer before acceptance.
purpose: Give farmers and reviewers a compact takeaway from the same API result rather than a second calculation.
